records.question: A Python provider’s last secret retrieval and ordinary refresh check both complete at t=0. It uses a versionless Key Vault reference, refresh_interval=60 and secret_refresh_interval=300. The app calls refresh() only at t=120,240,360,..., and each call succeeds within one second. The sentinel stays unchanged; a new enabled secret version is stored at t=200. Which is the first listed call whose timing permits the secret to be re-resolved?
